description: Renders a nav element with aria-label="pagination". Page links are keyboard-focusable and the active page is marked with aria-current="page". Previous/next controls are standard links or buttons.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between pagination links and controls
Activates the focused page link or navigation control
Activates the focused page link when rendered as a button

focus.notes: Focus ring appears on each focusable pagination link. Disabled previous/next controls are removed from the tab order.

announcements: The nav landmark is announced with its "pagination" label
The active page is announced via aria-current="page"
Previous and next links announce their labels

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for page numbers and navigation labels)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for active page indicator, borders, and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Ensure aria-current="page" is set on the active page link
Provide aria-label on the nav element if multiple pagination instances exist on a page
Disable or hide previous/next controls at the boundaries rather than allowing no-op clicks
